title: Resume start-step wiring branch (form-resume → firstIncompleteIndex) pinned only at pure-function level
detail: Frozen I/O matrix and AC require resume to start the stepper at the first incomplete section. firstIncompleteIndex has pure pins, but no test drives initBrowser (grep confirms; E2E covers pristine pages only, email round-trip is manual). Reverting the ternary to 0 fails no test.
recommended_fix: Add a wiring-level pin: export an _initBrowser(env) seam like form_draft.js and assert the resume render's initial step, or a bug-hunt scenario on a seeded resume page.

title: Failed-save dirty-retry path in form_draft.js saveNow has no wiring test
detail: The stated retry contract (non-OK response or rejected fetch leaves state dirty so the next trigger/beacon re-sends) is unpinned: form_draft_wiring.test.js covers success dedupe and the closed-vacancy terminal, never a transient failure followed by re-trigger.
recommended_fix: Add a wiring case: responder ok:false (non-closed) or rejecting fetch, then a second step change, asserting a second fetch fires with the same payload.

title: application_draft updated_at trigger (N5 fix) has no test asserting it fires
evidence:
CREATE TRIGGER update_application_draft_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON application_draft
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();
detail: The trigger is now the only updated_at writer on upsert/claim/mark_resumed (no manual SET there); strip_draft_on_submit still SETs it manually, masking trigger loss on that path. No test references application_draft.updated_at, so a dropped trigger fails silently.
recommended_fix: One integration assertion: upsert over an existing draft, then assert updated_at advanced past creation; or document the column as informational-only and accept.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 (save/beacon/continue-link/resume-restore/tombstone/strip-on-submit/closed-refusal/never-persist filter) 100%. P1 ~93% (14/15; only the resume start-step wiring branch partial). Overall >85%. Round-2 pins verified against implementation: mint-at-save, 500 cap, 3/hr fan-out, tombstone guards, 10-min cooldown, upload-slot filter all trace to real assertions.
